groups.G: model execution, complete finite output contract, scenario application, source-integrity checks, and full evidence capture
groups.A: normal start, rotor and generator operation, pitch tracking, yaw alignment, and useful generation
groups.Q: bounded speeds, torque, power, actuator effort, ripple, and measurement quality
groups.M: wind-to-aerodynamic-to-drivetrain-to-generator causality plus physical hydraulic-pitch and electric-yaw actuation
groups.R: worst private operating-point performance across the declared wind range
groups.D: start and high-wind transition response, signed yaw recovery, and joint-disturbance recovery

scoring_rules.formula: G hard gate followed by a weighted geometric mean of A/Q/M/R/D
scoring_rules.multi_scenario_reduction: critical range and recovery metrics use the worst scenario
causal_caps: copied wind, pitch, or yaw commands without delayed measured response
missing hydraulic-force activity in any blade actuator
missing electric-yaw torque activity or one-sided yaw response
missing rotor-to-generator torque and power response
disconnected feedback or prescribed output motion
